artworks.title: Young Girl at the Keyboard
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Jan de Bray (formerly Gerrit Dou)
artworks.medium: chalk manner with roulette and burnishing printed in red ink on wove paper (proof)
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22 × 17.9 cm (8 11/16 × 7 1/16 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a woman sitting and holding an object. The woman is depicted in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to her right. She has delicate facial features with an emphasis on her eyes and mouth. She has her hair styled up with a ribbon and is wearing a garment with puffy sleeves and a shawl. The background is neutral, and there are circular markings along the edges of the drawing.

artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in a three-quarter position. She has high cheekbones, rounded eyes, and hair styled in a bun with loose strands framing her face. She wears a long-sleeved dress with a striped pattern and a shawl over her shoulders, holding a music book in her left hand and resting her right hand on a keyboard instrument.

artworks.description: The image depicts a young woman from the waist up, seated at an angle facing the viewer. She has delicate facial features, high cheekbones, and styled hair with curls and a ribbon securing it. She wears a long-sleeved garment with vertical stripes and a shawl on her shoulders. Her right hand is extended forward, and her left hand holds an open music score book on a small keyboard instrument. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Young Girl at the Keyboard

artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated person looking slightly to their right, with facial features including a slightly open mouth and eyes looking outward. The person has light-colored hair styled back with a decorative headpiece tied in a bow at the back. They wear a high-collared dress with long sleeves and a mantle or shawl draped over their shoulders. The person is holding a book with musical notation, resting on a keyboard instrument, and a date "1660" is inscribed in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Village with Pond
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Allart van Everdingen
artworks.medium: aquatint with some burnishing printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.4 × 28 cm (6 7/8 × 11 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene from an elevated point, offering a broad view. The horizon features outlines of trees and buildings, with a church spire standing out against the clouds. The brushstrokes suggest detail, capturing structures and foliage. The color scheme is primarily sepia, giving a vintage look. In the foreground, there are people, carts, barrels, and ducks. In the background, the church, buildings, and trees complete the rural scene.

artworks.title: Village with Pond
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Allart van Everdingen
artworks.medium: aquatint with some roulette work and burnishing printed in red-brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.4 × 28 cm (6 7/8 × 11 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned print depicting a bustling village scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, with a church spire rising into the sky. Buildings with thatched roofs and wood-plank structures are spread throughout the scene, and trees are also present. Close to the viewer, there are logs, a wooden barrel, patches of grass, and ducks swimming in a waterway. Villagers are shown engaging in various activities, such as riding horses, tending to carts, and conversing. In the distance, intricate linework is visible on the trees and buildings. The scene has a warm, monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Village with Pond

artworks.medium: aquatint with some roulette work printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.4 × 28 cm (6 7/8 × 11 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: This is a village scene depicted from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is depicted high in the composition, framed by tall trees and a steeple in the village. The brushstrokes suggest a detailed technique, adding texture to the architecture and natural elements. The color palette consists of warm browns and sepia tones. In the foreground, there are figures and wagons on a path, and in the distance, various buildings with thatched roofs are visible. The sky is depicted with soft, swirling cloud patterns, adding to the tranquil atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.description: The image displays a rustic scene with a view over a small village area. A church with a distinct steeple is seen amongst trees and houses in the center of the image. The sky is filled with clouds creating a pattern in the background. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, focusing on trees and architecture. The color palette is predominantly sepia-toned with various shades of brown. Figures engaged in daily activities, horses, carts, and rural life elements are visible. In the distance, aside from the church, there are masts of ships hinting at a nearby waterway or harbor.

artworks.title: Village with Pond

artworks.description: The image depicts a bird's-eye view of a rustic village scene. It includes cottages, people, and a church. The horizon line is near the top, showing the steeple of the church above other buildings. There are detailed brushstrokes depicting textures like thatched roofs and trees. The color palette is predominantly sepia. Closest to us, fallen logs and a wooden barrel are on the ground, with a horse-drawn cart nearby. Villagers are engaged in daily activities including interacting with livestock. In the distance, trees rise above rooftops, and a ship is visible behind the structures on the right side, suggesting a nearby waterway.

artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.7 × 6.6 cm (3 13/16 × 2 5/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person with a cup and a jug. The individual is sitting on a chair, holding a cup in one hand and a jug in the other. The person has a round face with subtle features and short hair under a cap. They are wearing a buttoned garment, knee-length trousers, socks, and buckled shoes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Seated Peasant with Jug

artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.8 × 6.7 cm (3 7/8 × 2 5/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a wooden chair facing slightly left. His left leg is bent and resting on a stool, while his right leg is on the ground. He is looking down at a glass in his right hand, with his left hand on a jug on his lap. He has short, light-colored hair, wears a round, dark hat, a long-sleeved yellow shirt under a green vest, red trousers, knee-high socks, and dark shoes. The background is neutral with a shadow on the wall behind him.

The style is reminiscent of an etching with fine line work and a monochromatic color palette of warm cream and muted brown.
